skysong.hud_editor.title: Move the HUD
skysong.hud_editor.hint: Drag to move  ·  Scroll to resize  ·  R resets  ·  Esc when you're done
skysong.hud_editor.nothing: The karaoke bar and the now playing card are both turned off
skysong.settings.title: Skysong
skysong.settings.preview.no_world: Join a world to see your changes right away.
skysong.settings.preview.no_music: Nothing is playing. Start a song, or turn on the demo song in the Music tab, to see your changes here.
skysong.settings.world_lyrics.tooltip: Show the line being sung as text floating in the world.
skysong.settings.placement.tooltip: Straight ahead: where you're looking when a line starts. Scattered: a new spot around you for every line. In the sky: big and far away, high up in front of you.
skysong.settings.animation.tooltip: Karaoke: words light up as they're sung. Fade: words appear one by one. Rise: lines float in and up. Wave: words bob along. Typewriter: letter by letter. Glitch: scrambled, then sharp. Drop: words fall into place. Zoom: words shrink into place.
skysong.settings.preset.tooltip: A ready-made look: animation, colours, karaoke style and size in one click.
skysong.settings.text_color.tooltip: Colour of the words that haven't been sung yet, like #FFFFFF. Used with the colour mode "One colour".
skysong.settings.highlight_color.tooltip: Colour of the word being sung, like #FFD966.
skysong.settings.karaoke_bar.tooltip: The line being sung as a subtitle, with the next line below it.
skysong.settings.now_playing_card.toolti: The song, a progress bar and whether lyrics were found.
skysong.settings.title_intro.tooltip: Shows the title big on screen when a new song starts.
skysong.settings.cinematic_bars.tooltip: Black bars at the top and bottom of the screen while music plays.
skysong.settings.hud_when_hidden.tooltip: Keep the karaoke bar, title intro and cinematic bars when the game HUD is hidden with F1. Handy for recording videos.
skysong.settings.lyrics_status.not_found: No lyrics found for this song
skysong.settings.lyrics_status.failed: Couldn't load lyrics. Is the internet down?
skysong.settings.demo_song.tooltip: Plays a short built-in song instead of your music, so you can try every look.
skysong.settings.offset.tooltip: Lyrics always too late? Move this up. Always too early? Move it down. For a single song, use the buttons below instead.
skysong.settings.open_lyrics_folder.tool: Put your own .lrc or .txt lyrics files here. They win over the ones from the internet.
skysong.settings.reset.confirm_details: Everything goes back to how it was when you installed Skysong, including where the HUD is.
skysong.controls.needs_spotify: Music controls need the Spotify login (Skysong settings, Music tab)
skysong.controls.no_volume_control: This Spotify device doesn't allow changing the volume
skysong.controls.premium_required: Spotify only allows controlling playback with Premium
skysong.settings.music_source.tooltip: Automatic: Spotify when you're logged in, otherwise whatever plays on your computer.
skysong.settings.spotify.help: Optional. Skysong already sees what plays on your computer. Logging in to Spotify also works when the music plays on your phone, and lets you control it from the game. It needs your own free Spotify app, which takes two minutes to make: create an app on the Spotify dashboard, tick "Web API", add the address below as Redirect URI, then copy the app's Client ID here.
skysong.settings.spotify.log_in.tooltip: Opens Spotify in your browser. Only a login token is saved, never your password.
skysong.settings.glow.tooltip: A soft halo in the highlight colour around the words in the world.
skysong.settings.depth3d.tooltip: Gives the words in the world some thickness.
skysong.settings.sparkles.tooltip: Little sparks fly off every word as it's sung.
skysong.settings.beat_zoom.tooltip: The view zooms in a tiny bit when a new line starts, like a cut in a music video.
skysong.song_offset.none: Lyrics on the song's own timing
skysong.song_offset.earlier: Lyrics %s s earlier for this song
skysong.song_offset.later: Lyrics %s s later for this song
skysong.settings.song_offset.nothing_pla: Play a song to correct its timing
skysong.settings.song_offset.earlier: Lyrics too late? Show them earlier
skysong.settings.song_offset.earlier.too: Moves the lyrics of the song that's playing a quarter second earlier. Remembered for this song only.
skysong.settings.song_offset.later: Lyrics too early? Show them later
skysong.settings.song_offset.later.toolt: Moves the lyrics of the song that's playing a quarter second later. Remembered for this song only.
skysong.settings.color_mode.tooltip: One colour: the text colour. Flowing gradient: the two gradient colours drift through the line. Rainbow: every colour, slowly moving. The word being sung always lights up in the highlight colour.
skysong.settings.gradient_start.tooltip: First colour of the flowing gradient.
skysong.settings.gradient_end.tooltip: Second colour of the flowing gradient.
skysong.settings.estimate_word_timing.to: Most lyrics only say when each line starts. On: words light up one by one at a guessed time, which can run ahead when a note is held. Off: a line's words come together. Lyrics with real word timing always go word by word.
skysong.settings.debug_overlay.tooltip: Shows in the top left where the player says the song is, which time the lyrics use, and which lyrics were found. Helps to find out why lyrics are early or late.
skysong.settings.react_to_song.tooltip: The chorus is drawn bigger, the song's title stands out and jumps when it's sung, background vocals in brackets step back, and held notes grow while they're held (with word timing).
skysong.settings.font.tooltip: The font of the lyrics in the world, the karaoke bar and the title intro.
skysong.settings.showcase.tooltip: A camera films you like a music video, cutting to a new shot on every line and turning round you at the end of the song. You stand still; only your own view changes. Stops when you take damage, or with the showcase key (set it in Controls).
skysong.showcase.started: Showcase: the camera films you. Press the showcase key to stop.
skysong.settings.listen_to_music.tooltip: Listens to the sound your computer plays to find the beat: lyrics pulse on it, drops zoom the view, and the showcase cuts on the beat. The sound is only analysed on the spot, never saved or sent anywhere.
skysong.settings.debug_log.tooltip: Shows what Skysong does, live, in a panel you can move with "Move HUD": songs found, where the lyrics come from, logins, problems.
skysong.settings.copy_debug_log.tooltip: Copies the last 300 log entries, to paste them wherever you need them, e.g. in a bug report.
